portfolio.description:
Introduction

Rip Hunter is an innovative web security tool developed by Farham Aghdasi for the Khwarizmi Youth Festival in the programming category. It prevents unauthorized website ripping (downloading entire websites offline) and copying across platforms like HTML, PHP, Node.js, and React. Tailored for website owners and template sellers on platforms like RTL-Theme.com, Rip Hunter blocks malicious rippers, monitors traffic in real-time, and offers customizable protections with zero performance impact. It secured 2nd place in national skills competitions and 3rd place in the Khwarizmi festival.



Core Features

Rip Hunter includes a landing page, a comprehensive user dashboard, a server-side firewall (PHP and Node.js), and client-side scripts (Vanilla JS/jQuery and React versions). Key features include:

  • Real-time monitoring of visitors and rippers via interactive charts and logs.
  • Automated blocking of suspicious IPs, stored in .htaccess or databases.
  • Customizable restrictions: disable right-click, source code viewing, and domain/protocol limits.
  • Telegram bot alerts for detected threats.
  • HTML file encryption and decryption tools.
  • Crawler simulator to test protections.
  • Backup/restore database, account management, and light/dark theme toggles.



Detection Algorithms

Rip Hunter uses four advanced algorithms to detect and block rippers:

  • User Agent Analysis: Identifies non-browser agents (e.g., Python-urllib vs. Chrome) using a predefined ripper list.
  • Traffic Monitoring: Tracks data consumption and request rates over 60 seconds, blocking IPs exceeding thresholds (>10MB or >100 requests).
  • Malicious Link Trap: Inserts hidden links that only rippers follow, triggering instant blocks.
  • Machine Learning: Stacked models classify users as normal (2), suspicious (1), or malicious (0) based on live data.

Additional algorithms handle subdomain checks, XSS prevention, and data logging.



Client-Side Protections

The client-side module enhances security by restricting:

  • Domain and protocol enforcement.
  • Disabled developer tools, right-click, and source viewing.
  • React pre-render protections to prevent early source access.



Innovation and Advantages

Rip Hunter’s lightweight design ensures no performance overhead, unlike competitors. It reduces server load, analyzes ripper origins (ISP, country), and provides graphical analytics for visitor vs. ripper ratios.

Comparison with Competitors:

FeatureRip HunterCloudflare (Competitor)
Performance ImpactNone (background processing)High (slows down site loading)
Ripper Blocking GuaranteeHigh (multi-algorithm + ML)Variable (no specific anti-ripper focus)
CustomizationExtensive (per-platform configs, real-time dashboard)Limited to general security rules
CostFree/Open for integration, commercial use in templatesPaid tiers for advanced features
Platform SupportHTML, PHP, Node.js, ReactGeneral web, less targeted

Rip Hunter excels with its targeted anti-ripping focus, ML-driven detection, and seamless integration for high-value content sites.



Commercialization

Integrated into HTML templates sold on RTL-Theme.com (Rastchin), Rip Hunter protects templates from unauthorized copying, enhancing sales security. Examples include dashboards like 'Daftar' and 'Gridya'. It prevents offline ripping, ensuring buyers cannot redistribute content, boosting trust and revenue for template sellers.

portfolio.Shortdescription: Rip Hunter is an advanced web security tool that prevents unauthorized website ripping and copying using multi-algorithm detection, machine learning, and a user-friendly dashboard, offering superior performance over competitors like Cloudflare.

portfolio.description:
Platform Overview

Hossein Dehnavi is a comprehensive Persian RTL content, social, and business management platform built with Laravel 12, Turbo Drive, and Alpine.js. It combines a public-facing content experience with a powerful admin CMS, handling blog publishing, Instagram-style stories, explore feed, threaded discussions, business directory, and partner showcases.


Architecture & Tech Stack

The backend runs on Laravel 12 with 48 Eloquent models, 48 controllers, and a multi-guard authentication system supporting standard users, admins, and passwordless thread guests. The frontend uses Turbo + Alpine.js for SPA-like transitions, Tailwind CSS for RTL-aware styling, and Vite for asset bundling. A custom CacheVersion system provides monotonic per-domain cache invalidation without Redis.


Key Features

  • Blog System — Rich-text editor, threaded comments with nested replies, like/save, view tracking, category/tag filtering, and comment moderation.
  • Stories & Reels — Instagram-style viewer with progress bars, video caching via MSE + Cache API, swipe gestures, keyboard navigation, and 30-minute view deduplication.
  • Explore Feed — Server-rendered initial load, randomized order, masonry grid, infinite scroll, reels viewer with prefetching, 3-level nested comments, and search suggestions.
  • Threads — Passwordless guest auth via canvas fingerprint, nested replies, image attachments, optimistic likes, debounced search, and tag system.
  • Business Directory — Rich profiles with galleries, videos, menus, working hours with real-time open/closed status, reviews with star ratings, amenity tags, and similar-business ranking.
  • Media Library — Full file browser with folder tree, pagination, bulk upload, rename/move, metadata editing, and media picker modal.
  • Admin CMS — 60+ admin routes, SEO meta management, hero banners, home action items, settings with multi-language support, translation management, and system commands.


Security & Performance

The platform implements Google2FA with QR provisioning and recovery codes, device tracking, session fingerprinting, ban system, rate limiting, CSRF protection, and soft deletes. Performance features include Service Worker caching, lazy image loading, video prefetching, concurrent upload control, debounced search, HTML minification, and slow-request profiling logging queries over 2000ms.
portfolio.Shortdescription: A comprehensive Persian RTL content, social, and business management platform built with Laravel 12, Turbo, and Alpine.js. Features blog publishing, Instagram-style stories, explore feed, threaded discussions, business directory, and full admin CMS.

portfolio.description:
Platform Overview

Kara Chem is a bilingual Persian/English corporate website for a chemical company built with Laravel 13, Vite 8, and Tailwind CSS v4. The platform features a full dashboard, advanced SEO system, TipTap blog editor, product catalog with AJAX filtering, global search, and seamless RTL/LTR direction switching.


Architecture & Tech Stack

The backend uses Laravel 13.21 with 18 controllers and 8 Eloquent models across 22 migrations. The frontend leverages Vite 8 for bundling, Tailwind CSS v4 for styling, and Swiper for mobile-first sliders. Interactive experiences are powered by GSAP/SplitText for text animations, TipTap for rich-text editing, ApexCharts for analytics, and Lenis for smooth scrolling optimized for low CPU usage.


Key Features

  • Home Page — Hero section, gallery slider, about section, experience slider with odometer stats, services, FAQ accordion, and news section.
  • Shop & Products — Product catalog with AJAX filtering/search, slug-based product detail pages with image galleries, and responsive mobile-first design with 1 slide per view.
  • Blog — TipTap rich-text editor with image blocks, author avatars, detail pages, and SEO-friendly URLs.
  • Contact — Contact form with dashboard management and submission tracking.
  • Global Search — AJAX-powered search with skeleton loading states for instant results.
  • SEO System — Per-locale meta tags stored in database, automated schema.org JSON-LD generation for Organization/Article/Product, XML sitemaps with hreflang alternates, OG/Twitter cards, canonical URLs, and HTML minification middleware.
  • Dashboard — Product management with galleries and content blocks, blog management, page management, contact inbox, visitor analytics with ApexCharts, settings with multi-language support, translation management, theme/media/document management, and profile management.


Performance & Localization

The application implements content caching, native image lazy loading, HTML minification, and WebP image optimization. Localization is handled via a custom DbFileLoader that merges file translations with database overrides, with automatic RTL/LTR direction switching via middleware. Split-text animations are disabled in RTL to preserve Persian script joining.
portfolio.Shortdescription: A bilingual Persian/English corporate website for a chemical company built with Laravel 13, Vite 8, and Tailwind CSS v4. Features a full dashboard, advanced SEO, blog, product catalog, and RTL/LTR support.
